exercises.why: **признаёте** — признава́ть (imperfective): to recognize (to acknowledge the existence or legality of something); to acknowledge, to see, to admit, to own; to find, to consider, to declare, to pronounce. Wiktionary: призна́ть + -ва́ть.

pairs: to know: to be familiar with or accustomed to a person, place, or thing
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: знать — to know: to be familiar with or accustomed to a person, place, or thing; узна́ть — to recognize; созна́ние — consciousness (awareness); позна́ние — cognition, perception.
